His "Robinocracy" was lampooned in several plays by Henry Fielding, causing him to introduce the Licensing Act of 1737. For 10 points, name this Whig Prime Minister who was roundly attacked for his corruption during the reign of George I.

The Scottish admiral Samuel Greig won the Battle of Cheshme for this ruler, which eventually led to the Treaty of Kuchuk Kainarji.
